_readme: Real, named bucketlistt team members that generated articles are credited to (byline + JSON-LD Person schema). Do NOT put a fictional/invented name here — Google's E-E-A-T guidance requires a real, verifiable person, and a made-up author is a trust violation, not a fix. The generator rotates between these entries. 'job_title' is left blank until confirmed — a wrong title is worse than no title; fill in the real one when known. 'url' is optional: leave it "" until a real author bio page exists on the site (see documentation/WEBSITE_SEO_CHANGES.md, item #5), then point it there.
